items.title: General post-layout channel extraction
items.baseline: Experimental planar geometry paths, supplied uniform lossless/Heaviside transients, independent sampled scalar RLGC networks and driven RMS fields/loss ledgers. Ordered supplied scalar sections now connect through ideal common-reference junctions, with coherent local fields, raw interface residuals and section/global loss balance. Physical geometry/return/discontinuity extraction, branches, causal material laws and thermal deposition remain open. Supplied ideal scalar star junctions now retain coherent leg fields and conserved distributed heat across named external ports. Supplied symmetric even/odd coupled pairs now reconstruct physical four-port conductor fields and pair-owned losses; no geometric/modal extraction is inferred. Explicit sampled physical resistive sources/loads now close the supplied symmetric pair, with terminal-resistor and line heat kept separately; no inferred geometry or thermal deposition. Sampled physical series-R/L and node-shunt-C sources/loads now close the supplied symmetric pair, keeping heat W separate from mean energy J and reactive var; no inferred geometry or thermal deposition. Ordered supplied symmetric coupled sections now compose through ideal conductor-continuous interfaces, with actual fields and section-owned integrated heat; no geometry-derived discontinuity parasitics or thermal deposition. Supplied piecewise coupled channels now admit physical RLC source/load voltages, retaining actual section fields and separate terminal/section heat W versus mean J and reactive var; no inferred contact/thermal mapping. Supplied uniform coupled legs now form ideal two-conductor stars with coherent exterior scattering/internalfields, conservednodevoltage/current/power and separatelyownedlegheat; no inferredgeometricjunction or thermalallocation. Coupled stars now admit complete physical RLC source/load voltages with actual branch fields and explicit terminal/branch heat W versus mean J and reactive var; boundary integrity includes a limited roundoff operand allowance without changing physical values or board gates.
items.target: Branches, layer changes, return planes, explicit single-ended/differential/multiconductor PCB/coax/cable classes; frequency-dependent RLGC, distributed delay and reflections, geometry coverage and converged extraction.

benchmark.acceptance: Define task-specific fixture, observables, reference and tolerances before implementation/qualification.

open_gaps: Qualified branches, layer changes, return planes, coupled PCB/coax/cable geometry and physical interface/fringing/launch/via/bend models; causal complex constitutive laws/dispersive energy, skin/proximity/material extraction, general distributed states/terminations and DC/transient lossy fields; heat allocation, conservative thermal mapping/feedback and measured/converged extraction. Ideal scalar supplied-section junctions do not establish these capabilities.
